sig: [[["A", "Thanks for calling Brightline Home Goods, this is Sara. How can I help?"], ["B", "Hi, my name's Liam Doyle. I ordered a glass dining table, and it arrived this morning with a crack right across the top."], ["A", "Oh, I'm so sorry to hear that. Was the box itself damaged when it was delivered?"], ["B", "Yeah, one corner was crushed. Luckily, I took photos before I opened it."], ["A", "That's really helpful. If you email those to us, I can file a claim with the courier today."], ["B", "Fine, but I've got eight people coming for dinner on the twentieth. I can't exactly wait three weeks for a replacement."], ["A", "Understood. Normally replacements take ten business days, but our Leeds warehouse has that model in stock, so I can send one by express. It'd reach you on the eighteenth."], ["B", "That's cutting it close, but it works. And what about the broken one?"], ["A", "Our driver will collect it when he drops off the new table, so there's nothing you need to do."], ["B", "Great. Where should I send the photos?"], ["A", "I'll text you a link right after this call."]], {"A": "F-US", "B": "M-AU"}]
